question: What causes users to postpone a purchase?
summary: Prices and cloth ranges are good but if i wishlist something for later it ends up either getting stocked out and never returns back in stock for months

sub_themes.name: Fabric quality doubt
paraphrased_examples: Prices and cloth ranges are good but if i wishlist something for later it ends up either getting stocked out and never returns back in stock for months
sub_themes.hypothesis: Fabric quality doubt may delay 30-day wishlist conversion.
interview_probes: When you saved something recently, did fabric quality doubt come up?

sub_themes.name: Other
paraphrased_examples: Third rate customer service. they was around 15mins on call waiting for customer service support, yet not received. on chat support executive not replying for more than 10mins. product quality is worst yet not able…
interview_probes: When you saved something recently, did other come up?

implications: Shoppers defer with later, payday, and not-sure-yet language. A non-promo reminder tied to occasion or timing beats forgetting.
